verdict.rationale: Yapily's Payments API explicitly supports scheduled, periodic, and variable recurring payments (yapily-docs-1, yapily-docs-16, yapily-docs-17, yapily-docs-5), which an AI agent could invoke via the API (and MCP-connected docs, yapily-docs-6/32) to set up recurring financial workflows. However, this is domain-specific payment scheduling, not a general-purpose job/workflow scheduler for arbitrary AI-driven automations, and there's no evidence of a broader orchestration or cron-like automation layer for agent workflows. Missing for 10: a general workflow/job scheduling mechanism beyond payment initiation, and independent/hands-on confirmation that AI agents can reliably trigger recurring jobs end-to-end.
